title: •Bargaining Table
caption: •Bargaining Table (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your unique (•) aliens are forfeit +1. Your unique (•) aliens with printed deploy costs greater than or equal to printed forfeit are deploy -1 and forfeit +1. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Attark, Crell, Ghoel, Laudica, Leslomy, Loje, or Vul. {alter}
lore: The alcoves of Jabba’s palace are good places to make deals and place bets. Jabba gets a cut of the profits, of course.

notes: Unique (•). Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Slip differs from the stub: slip 'printed deploy costs' (stub 'cost'); stub writes (*) for the uniqueness dots, slip prints (•). ▼ where the stub expands the phrase; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Lore: curly apostrophe in Jabba’s (wiki straight); otherwise matches. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1998 (Jabba's Palace) not legible on it. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
